definition: to cut vegetables into small pieces
translation: thái rau củ, băm rau củ
exampleSentence: I chop vegetables for the soup.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thái rau củ để nấu súp.

definition: to cut bread into thin flat pieces
exampleSentence: He slices the bread for sandwiches.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy cắt lát bánh mì để làm bánh kẹp.

definition: to remove the skin of potatoes
exampleSentence: My daughter peels potatoes for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Con gái tôi gọt vỏ khoai tây cho bữa tối.

definition: to rub cheese on a grater to make small pieces
exampleSentence: Grate some cheese on the pasta.
exampleTranslation: Bào ít phô mai lên mì ống.

definition: to stir different foods together
exampleSentence: Mix the ingredients in a large bowl.
exampleTranslation: Trộn các nguyên liệu trong một cái bát lớn.

definition: to move a spoon round in the soup
exampleSentence: Stir the soup so it doesn't burn.
exampleTranslation: Khuấy súp để nó không bị cháy.

definition: to mix eggs quickly until they are light
exampleSentence: Whisk the eggs with a little salt.
exampleTranslation: Đánh trứng với một chút muối.

definition: to mix eggs hard with a fork
exampleSentence: Beat the eggs, then add the milk.
exampleTranslation: Đánh trứng, rồi cho sữa vào.

definition: to break the shell of an egg
exampleSentence: Crack two eggs into the bowl.
exampleTranslation: Đập hai quả trứng vào bát.

definition: to press and fold dough with your hands
exampleSentence: Knead the dough for ten minutes.
exampleTranslation: Nhào bột trong mười phút.

definition: to cook a cake in the oven
exampleSentence: I bake a cake for every birthday.
exampleTranslation: Sinh nhật nào tôi cũng nướng một chiếc bánh.

definition: to cook a whole chicken in the oven
exampleSentence: We roast a chicken on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật nào chúng tôi cũng quay một con gà.

definition: to cook fish under or over strong heat
exampleSentence: He grills fish on the barbecue.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy nướng cá trên vỉ nướng.

definition: to cook rice using hot steam
translation: hấp cơm, nấu cơm bằng hơi nước
exampleSentence: We steam rice in a rice cooker.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nấu cơm bằng nồi cơm điện.

definition: to prepare rice by heating it in water
exampleSentence: I cook rice every evening.
exampleTranslation: Chiều nào tôi cũng nấu cơm.

definition: to cook the sauce gently just below boiling
exampleSentence: Simmer the sauce for twenty minutes.
exampleTranslation: Om nước sốt nhỏ lửa trong hai mươi phút.

definition: to add salt and other tastes to food
exampleSentence: Season the meat with salt and pepper.
exampleTranslation: Nêm thịt với muối và tiêu.

definition: to put salt into food
exampleSentence: Don't add too much salt.
exampleTranslation: Đừng cho quá nhiều muối.

definition: to heat the oven before you put food in
exampleSentence: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
exampleTranslation: Làm nóng lò trước ở 180 độ.

definition: to start the heat on the cooker
exampleSentence: Turn on the stove and heat the pan.
exampleTranslation: Bật bếp và làm nóng chảo.

definition: to make the cooker less hot
exampleSentence: Turn down the heat when the water boils.
exampleTranslation: Giảm lửa khi nước sôi.

definition: to stop the heat on the cooker
exampleSentence: Did you turn off the stove?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đã tắt bếp chưa?

definition: to make the oil hot in a pan
exampleSentence: Heat the oil before you add the onions.
exampleTranslation: Làm nóng dầu trước khi cho hành vào.

definition: to cook onions in hot oil
exampleSentence: Fry the onions until they are soft.
exampleTranslation: Xào hành cho đến khi mềm.

definition: to pour the water off cooked pasta
exampleSentence: Drain the pasta and add the sauce.
exampleTranslation: Chắt nước mì ống rồi cho nước sốt vào.

definition: to try a little soup to check the flavour
exampleSentence: Taste the soup. Does it need more salt?
exampleTranslation: Nếm thử súp đi. Có cần thêm muối không?

definition: to put food on plates for people to eat
translation: dọn đồ ăn ra, bày món
exampleSentence: I serve the food while it is hot.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dọn đồ ăn ra khi còn nóng.

definition: to cook by doing what the recipe says
exampleSentence: I can follow a recipe well.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nấu theo công thức khá tốt.

definition: to find out how much flour you have, using a cup or scales
exampleSentence: Measure the flour carefully.
exampleTranslation: Đong bột mì cho cẩn thận.

definition: to put oil or butter on a pan so food does not stick
translation: phết dầu hoặc bơ vào chảo
exampleSentence: Grease the pan before you pour the batter in.
exampleTranslation: Phết dầu vào khuôn trước khi đổ bột vào.

definition: to let frozen meat become soft and ready to cook
exampleSentence: I defrost the meat in the fridge overnight.
exampleTranslation: Tôi để thịt rã đông trong tủ lạnh qua đêm.

definition: to leave meat in a sauce before you cook it
exampleSentence: Marinate the meat for an hour.
exampleTranslation: Ướp thịt trong một tiếng.

definition: to choose how long before a timer rings
exampleSentence: Set the timer for ten minutes.
exampleTranslation: Đặt hẹn giờ mười phút.

definition: to wait until hot food is not hot any more
exampleSentence: Let the cake cool before you cut it.
exampleTranslation: Để bánh nguội rồi hãy cắt.

definition: to clean vegetables with water
exampleSentence: Wash the vegetables before you cook them.
exampleTranslation: Rửa rau củ trước khi nấu.
